findings.title: ZDI-26-342: Progress LoadMaster apiuser Uninitialized Memory Remote Code Execution Vulnerability (Zero Day Initiative)
findings.summary_md: Zero Day Initiative published the coordinated advisory for CVE-2026-8037 on June 9, 2026, crediting Syed Ibrahim Ahmed of TrendAI Research. Its disclosure timeline records the vulnerability was reported to the vendor on April 15, 2026, roughly seven weeks before the coordinated public release. The advisory frames the flaw as an uninitialized memory condition in the LoadMaster API's apiuser handling that leads to remote code execution.

findings.title: LoadMaster Critical Security Bulletin - June 2026 (CVE-2026-8037, CVE-2026-33691) (Progress Software)
findings.summary_md: Progress's June 2026 bulletin, which watchTowr dates to June 4 (the community page itself carries a July 31, 2026 last-modified stamp), covers critical command injection CVE-2026-8037 in the LoadMaster API and high-severity CVE-2026-33691, an OWASP Core Rule Set whitespace-padded filename bypass of file upload extension checks. It affects GA v7.2.63.1 and older, LTSF v7.2.54.17 and older, plus ECS Connection Manager and Connection Manager for ObjectScale v7.2.63.1 and older, fixed in GA v7.2.63.2 and LTSF v7.2.54.18. At publication Progress stated it had received no reports of exploitation and knew of no indicators of compromise; a companion MOVEit WAF bulletin covers the same two CVEs.

findings.title: Enterprise Tech In, Shell Out (Progress Kemp LoadMaster Uninitialized Heap to Pre-Auth RCE CVE-2026-8037) (watchTowr Labs)
findings.summary_md: watchTowr's Sina Kheirkhah published the full technical analysis on June 29, 2026, showing the June patch's only functional changes to escape_quotes() were malloc becoming calloc and a missing null terminator being added. The vulnerable code splices the unterminated escaped apiuser value into a validuser command line executed via system(), so their exploit POSTs to /accessv2 with apiuser set to four single quotes, whose escape expansion overwrites 16 bytes of heap allocator metadata, while sprayed JSON parameters carry the command payload, yielding pre-auth RCE without any credentials.
